svg.text: OmniRose sun pelorus
Read where the anticlockwise edge of the can's shadow crosses the scale.
1. Print at actual size (100%).
The bar at the bottom should
measure exactly 100 mm.
2. Stick it to something flat and
fix it level, with the BOW line
parallel to the centreline.
3. Stand a can, or anything upright with
straight sides, on the circle that fits it.
Note where its line meets the scale.
No shadow on the scale? Wait for a lower sun.
4. Hold each heading until the compass
settles. Then note the time, the compass,
and the anticlockwise edge of the shadow.
BOW
STERN
diameter (mm)
100 mm
